learnerAssets.practiceActivities: one active activity for every distinct Blueprint-selected practice evidence mode on every requirement; exact count is deterministically asserted rather than used as a quota

evidenceBoundary.practice: not evidence eligible until Step 5 Marking Packs/evidence mappings exist where applicable
evidenceBoundary.examPrep: not evidence eligible until Step 5 Marking Packs/evidence mappings exist where applicable
evidenceBoundary.rule: Step 4 may produce teaching, active practice and exam-preparation candidates; it must not manufacture readiness claims before governed marking/evidence contracts exist.

rights.subjectTruth: inherits rights-safe OPEN/LICENSED/REVISION_OWNED provenance from completed Course Truth

economics.manualIntervention: One deterministic builder and assurance contract assemble the complete candidate corpus from already-governed truth/Blueprint inputs; no per-requirement paid generation call is required.
economics.catalogueScaleHypothesis: If independent assurance finds the deterministic educational treatment adequate after bounded remediation, this removes learner-asset generation spend as a primary catalogue-scaling cost.

documentationImpact.note: This applies the existing source-first run and Course Learning Blueprint authority. Step 7 remains responsible for canonical learner-runtime integration.

nextWork.priority: Build Marking Packs and evidence mappings for scored/assisted-marking Practice and Exam Prep candidates, then run production-level independent educational and assessment assurance before Step 7 runtime integration.
nextWork.rule: Do not mark Step 4 candidates as scored/evidence-eligible or pilot-publication-ready until the downstream gates pass.

publicationBoundary: Experimental candidate learner corpus only. Completion of Step 4 does not authorise learner publication, scored readiness evidence, canonical runtime integration or restricted-pilot release.
